youtube_description:
A fun video for VR goggles. You'll be able to see the fish in the water and enjoy the Lilly-pad water. Also, make sure and download the 4K version to see the best details. 

We didn't film much of a recap today. Basically, it's less than a mile around Lake Katherine and you can walk or bike as far as you'd like in either direction along the cal-sag trail. So, make this hike your own. 

Subscribe to us here on YouTube for daily 360° VR hiking experiences.
